notes: A booked mention could be left out of a newsletter when your template had slightly more slots than bookings. There are now always at least as many slots as books.
A day read from your calendar could list one author twice and miss another. SwapWright waits for the day to load fully, and stops rather than guessing.
Swap runs no longer report a Solo you cannot offer back as an error, and say which setting is limiting the run.
